sentence: This project tries to bring artificial intelligence, uncrewed aerial systems and environmental sensor networks into digital forestry and natural resource management.
This project builds course materials and a hands-on laboratory kit that teach how to protect drones from cyber-attacks.
This project studies how living organisms and their environments affect each other, using lab and field research.
This project tests a control system that sends optical signals through fiber and uses low-power electronics to run superconducting quantum computers.
This project builds a school of three robotic fish that share information and work together underwater with a buoy.
This project builds a tool that pulls structured information out of scientific documents without relying on costly expert annotations.
This project builds chemical tools that use gold to attach to flexible proteins inside living cells and change how they work.
This project develops mathematical foundations and algorithms for understanding optimization and generalization in neural networks.
This project tries to speed up computing for artificial intelligence by doing computation with photonic circuits and image sensors.
This project studies how defects in end-linked polymer networks control strain-induced crystallization and their mechanical properties.
This project develops a molecule that shifts its chemical signature under force from microbubbles to measure stress during therapeutic ultrasound.
This project studies how water stored in the critical zone affects processes in montane watersheds when the environment changes.
This project tries to find out why polymers crack too early or become distorted in contact with specific fluids.
This project tests whether mission-based learning improves how cybersecurity is taught in an existing computer science course.
This project studies excitons, which are electron and hole pairs, in topological materials by measuring photocurrent.
This project studies how microgravity and the rigidity of growth substrates change how mesenchymal stem cells affect the immune response.
This project builds machine learning tools that rebuild the magnetic field around Earth during magnetic storms.
This project builds artificial intelligence models to find where enough water exists to support data centers.
